question: Should OpenClaw retire `coalesceSameSenderDms` now and make `imsg` 0.11.1 a hard iMessage startup floor, accepting doctor and binary-upgrade actions for existing users?
rationale: This intentionally turns previously accepted persisted configuration and older binaries into fail-closed upgrade states; tests establish mechanics but cannot choose that compatibility policy.

options.title: Approve after final-head proof
options.body: Accept the transition after conflicts are resolved and a real macOS run verifies doctor migration, old-version recovery guidance, and one-turn split-send delivery.

options.title: Defer the teardown
options.body: Retain the current option and client-side fallback until maintainers are ready to require the config and binary upgrade together.

recommendation.title: Approve after final-head proof
recommendation.body: Accept the transition after conflicts are resolved and a real macOS run verifies doctor migration, old-version recovery guidance, and one-turn split-send delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on the supported `imsg` release floor and operator upgrade policy for that dependency.
